supersedes: Only the blanket Draft3-boolean selector in R2-SOL-PYTHON-SCHEMA-REFERENCE-TERMINALS-001 and subject-phase mapping interpretation. Frozen observations and other mappings remain unchanged.

nativeMechanism.explanation: Resource.pointer accumulates typed segments and asks the active dialect specification whether each reached value is a subresource. When the resolver changes it clears the accumulated segments. Draft3 legacy id inspection can raise before descend when the reached subresource is boolean; ordinary descend handles a boolean reached through an unknown annotation as true/false normally.

draft3Sets.specialItemsDependencies: items/dependencies enter a subresource only when reached contents are Mapping.

nativeDistinction: #/definitions/no with false reached as recognized Draft3 subresource raises TypeError during legacy id inspection.
#/x-target with false through unknown annotation does not cross that boundary; descend emits ordinary false-schema error.
nativeMechanism.target: Preserve actual dialect/source subresource classification, not blanket target-kind or fixture-id heuristics. Use existing exact Draft3 deterministic evaluation reason only for the native subresource-classification refusal; ordinary boolean descend stays ordinary validation.

arrayIndexProfile.target: Python consumer references preserve urllib fragment percent decoding, Python int grammar and Python sequence negative indexing, then bounds/refusal. This includes signs, allowed whitespace, Unicode decimal digits, underscores and leading zeros. Ordinary ECMA/Bun schema pointer profile is unchanged.
arrayIndexProfile.resource: Validate syntax and bound needed index magnitude before allocating. Do not allocate an arbitrary huge BigInt merely to reject an out-of-range array index. Preserve runtime terminal versus admission phase; Context before owned work.

typedSchemaPathInterface.requirement: Preserve exact mixed string/integer segment types in existing facade absolute_schema_path and schema_path after reference target-relative display rebasing. Numeric object keys remain strings.
typedSchemaPathInterface.interface: Trusted internal PythonStructuralError schema_path_segments: Key(PyText) or Index(usize/u64), or proven equivalent source locator. Populate from actual evaluation/source path and preserve through ref rebase/prefix/boolean omission operations. PyO3 projects typed list; facade consumes it rather than re-traversing original root.
typedSchemaPathInterface.resource: Meter vector/key copies before allocation; use shared source/path state when practical. No whole-root copy per node/error.
typedSchemaPathInterface.publicBoundaries: Public Diagnostic, interoperable Value and generic closed wire unchanged. Strict Value-only fallback remains separately qualified.
